chunks.title: Who Usaid Khan is
chunks.text:
Usaid Khan is a Software Engineer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. He works as a Software Development Engineer at Data Innovations Technologies Pvt. Ltd., where he has been full-time since April 2025 after joining as an intern in August 2024.

He describes himself as a full-stack engineer, DevOps practitioner and cloud-native enthusiast: comfortable from pixel-level web interfaces down to distributed systems running on Kubernetes. His day-to-day work centres on Java and Spring Boot microservices, React and Next.js front ends, Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and GitOps.

chunks.title: Professional summary
chunks.text:
Usaid is a Software Engineer with production experience across Java/Spring Boot backend systems, React/Next.js full-stack applications and enterprise integration work, backed by hands-on DevOps, cloud and CI/CD practice.

His track record includes root-causing data-integrity and concurrency bugs in financial systems, leading multi-screen accessibility and modernization initiatives, and building and validating AI-agent evaluation benchmarks. He works across the full stack, from PostgreSQL, Hibernate and Spring Data JPA query design, through JWT authentication, to React state management, and across the deployment pipeline from Docker and Kubernetes containerization to GitOps-based CI/CD.

chunks.title: Engineering philosophy and interests
chunks.text:
Usaid's engineering philosophy, in his own words: "Reduce complexity until the system becomes obvious, then automate everything that's left."

He is an open-source contributor (the SimpleAccounts accounting project) and enjoys exploring cloud-native patterns, test automation and SRE principles in his day-to-day work. The four themes he highlights about himself are Backend, Cloud-Native, DevOps and Automation.

At a glance the portfolio lists: 1+ years of professional experience, 10+ certifications and 15+ projects built.

The portfolio does not publish salary expectations, notice period, visa status or relocation preferences. For anything like that, contact him directly at usaidk.tech@gmail.com or use the "Hire Me" / contact form on this site.

chunks.title: Skills overview
chunks.text:
Usaid's core skills, by area:

- Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate / JPA, REST APIs and microservices.
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Angular and Tailwind CSS.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and MongoDB.
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, Helm, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and GitOps.
- Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
- Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, Vitest and Playwright.
- AI and automation: RAG, Spring AI, LLM integration, MCP servers and AI agents.

His strongest area is Java / Spring Boot backend engineering, combined with hands-on DevOps and cloud practice.

chunks.title: Programming and scripting languages
chunks.text:
Programming languages Usaid works with: Java, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, SQL and C.

Scripting and configuration languages: Bash, Python, Groovy and YAML.

Java is his primary backend language; JavaScript and TypeScript are what he uses for React and Next.js front ends.

chunks.title: Backend frameworks and architecture
chunks.text:
Backend and framework skills: Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Spring AI, Hibernate (ORM), JDBC, Servlets and JSP.

Architecture and API work: REST APIs, microservices architecture, MVC architecture, JMS / message-driven architecture and Apache Kafka.

Security: JWT, OAuth 2.0 and role-based access control (RBAC).

He also has a foundation in Core Java, collections, and data structures and algorithms.

chunks.title: Frontend skills
chunks.text:
Frontend skills: React.js, Next.js, Angular (including version migration), Redux Toolkit, React Router, react-hook-form, HTML5, CSS3 and Tailwind CSS.

He has also worked on React Native mobile apps (Android and iOS) with native Kotlin and Swift integrations, and has hands-on experience with accessibility work: WCAG-AA contrast remediation and dark/light theming across a 67-screen React front end.

chunks.title: Databases
chunks.text:
Databases Usaid works with: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle Database and MongoDB, with Liquibase for schema migration and Prisma ORM on the Node/Next.js side.

On the job he designs and optimizes PostgreSQL schemas, relationships, indexing strategies and complex queries, and has reduced query execution times by up to 40%.

chunks.title: DevOps, containers and CI/CD
chunks.text:
Containers and orchestration: Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, Helm charts and OpenShift.

CI/CD and DevOps: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitOps, ElectricFlow, Ansible, Maven and Gradle.

Systems: Linux administration, Bash and networking (subnetting, NAT, IP allowlisting).

In practice he containerizes services with Docker, deploys them across Kubernetes and Docker Swarm, and automates build, test and deployment through CI/CD pipelines, which reduced deployment effort by roughly 60%.

chunks.title: Cloud platforms
chunks.text:
Cloud platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure (including Azure Service Bus), Google Cloud Platform and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

He holds three Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certifications (Foundations Associate, AI Foundations and Generative AI Professional) and has supported containerized workloads on OpenShift and on Azure/AWS environments for an enterprise client.

chunks.title: Testing
chunks.text:
Testing tools: JUnit 5, Mockito, Vitest, Playwright (end-to-end and live-browser audits), Micronaut Test, integration testing and pytest.

Examples from his work: he added backend (JUnit 5 / Mockito) and frontend (Vitest) regression coverage for 20+ production bug fixes, built custom Playwright-based contrast and theme-inversion audit tooling, and verified an accessibility remediation against a 2,374-test Vitest suite.

chunks.title: Monitoring, observability and security operations
chunks.text:
Monitoring and observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk and Apache Kafka, plus audit logging, IAM and authentication/authorization.

He uses Splunk for production log analysis and root-cause investigation, and has studied site reliability engineering through the Linux Foundation's DevOps and SRE course and an SRE Fundamentals course.

chunks.title: AI and automation skills
chunks.text:
AI and automation skills: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), generative AI, Spring AI, LLM integration, MCP servers, AI agents, coding/CLI agents, vector databases, prompt engineering, AI-agent benchmark design and agentic evaluation.

He integrates Spring AI and LLM-driven workflows into business applications and uses CLI coding agents (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Qwen CLI, Antigravity) in his development process, which he credits with speeding up development by about 70%. He is an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified Generative AI Professional.

The assistant you are talking to is itself a small RAG system he added to this portfolio.

Tools and collaboration: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Maven, Gradle, Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, Slack and Microsoft Teams. IDEs and utilities: IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code and Postman.

Web and CMS platforms: WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce and Shopify, with which he has delivered 10+ client websites and storefronts.

chunks.title: Work history at a glance
chunks.text:
Usaid's work history:

1. Software Development Engineer, Data Innovations Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (April 2025 to present). Full-time role spanning a fintech/accounting SaaS platform (Spring Boot and React), a healthcare practice-management CMS (Next.js), and an enterprise financial-services client engagement.
2. Software Development Intern, Data Innovations Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (August 2024 to January 2025). Backend and API work, Docker and CI/CD, Linux, plus 10+ WordPress and e-commerce sites.

Alongside this he has done AI benchmark engineering projects with Handshake AI and Snorkel AI. In total he has a little over one year of professional experience.

chunks.title: SDE work: fintech / accounting SaaS platform
chunks.text:
As a Software Development Engineer at Data Innovations Technologies (April 2025 to present), Usaid works on a fintech / accounting SaaS platform built with Spring Boot and React. Highlights:

- Root-caused and fixed a Spring transaction-propagation defect that made bank-account creation report failure while the record was silently committed to PostgreSQL, by realigning transaction boundaries and enforcing explicit rollback.
- Eliminated a recurring falsy-zero pagination defect across 39 independent list/report screens in a React + Redux application.
- Resolved Hibernate LazyInitializationException crashes on production list endpoints by correcting @Transactional scoping, and hardened JWT handling so malformed tokens return 401 instead of 500, while removing token values from logs.
- Led a dark/light theme and WCAG-AA accessibility remediation across a 67-screen React front end, building Playwright-based audit tooling and cutting measured contrast failures from 38 to 0.
- Diagnosed a CSS cascade collision between Bootstrap and shadcn/ui and consolidated about 30 screens of duplicated dropdown styling into one design-token-driven module.
- Added JUnit 5/Mockito and Vitest regression coverage for 20+ production bug fixes.

chunks.title: SDE work: healthcare practice-management CMS
chunks.text:
At Data Innovations Technologies Usaid built a healthcare practice-management CMS and marketing platform with Next.js and React. Highlights:

- Built a database-backed content management system (Postgres, Prisma ORM) for a healthcare clinic's public site and admin dashboard, with JWT access/refresh-token authentication using hashed refresh tokens, audit logging, appointment booking, and blog/service/team content management.
- Migrated the public site from per-request, database-backed rendering to a fully static, build-time-generated Next.js architecture, removing the runtime database dependency while preserving SEO metadata, sitemap and structured data.
- Diagnosed and fixed an SSR/CSR hydration mismatch in a reduced-motion accessibility hook.
- Resolved a recurring build-and-deploy failure caused by a native image-processing dependency missing from the serverless bundle.
- Engineered a spam-resistant contact form pipeline with schema validation, honeypot fields, per-IP rate limiting and dual-recipient SMTP delivery.

chunks.title: SDE work: enterprise financial-services client engagement
chunks.text:
Usaid supported an enterprise retirement / investment-services web application (plan sponsors, compliance, aggregator and data-feed reporting) built on Java and Spring Boot, as part of a client engagement. Highlights:

- Contributed to core business logic, REST API development and validation across Dev, QA, ST, AT and Production environments.
- Investigated and resolved Azure Service Bus message-processing exceptions by analysing service-bus logs and correcting JMS/Spring Boot configuration; supported containerized workloads on OpenShift and Azure/AWS.
- Built integration tests for a microservice using Micronaut Test.
- Migrated a legacy Angular 13 application to Angular 21 in about one week while preserving existing functionality.
- Handled production issue investigation, root-cause analysis and remediation, using Splunk for logs and Jira/ServiceNow for tracking.
- Troubleshot enterprise network connectivity involving subnetting, NAT and firewall/IP allowlisting for Azure Pipelines and internal services.

- Integrates Spring AI / LLM-driven workflows and CLI coding agents into the development process to accelerate delivery.

chunks.title: Software Development Intern (Aug 2024 to Jan 2025)
chunks.text:
Usaid started at Data Innovations Technologies Pvt. Ltd. as a Software Development Intern (August 2024 to January 2025). During the internship he:

- Contributed to backend applications and API-driven workflows, including REST API integrations, JWT/OAuth 2.0 authentication and service-to-service communication.

The internship led into his full-time Software Development Engineer role at the same company.

chunks.title: Project: SimpleAccounts.io (open-source fintech)
chunks.text:
SimpleAccounts.io is an open-source accounting platform for modern businesses, and Usaid is a full-stack contributor to it.

He works across backend services, APIs, database workflows and application delivery. Highlights: 25+ production-ready features delivered across the platform; REST APIs, MVC architecture and database-driven business workflows; Docker-based development and GitOps-oriented deployment; contributions across feature development, integration, testing and deployment.

Tech stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate / JPA, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitOps.

chunks.title: Project: TherapyCRM.io (healthcare CRM)
chunks.text:
TherapyCRM.io is a healthcare CRM platform that powers workflows for therapy practices. Usaid contributed as a full-stack engineer across secure backend services, APIs, authentication, database operations and infrastructure.

Highlights: 50+ business endpoints with standardized API responses; JWT authentication, Spring Security and role-based access control; PostgreSQL optimization that reduced query times by up to 40%; microservices deployed through Kubernetes and Docker-based infrastructure.

chunks.title: Project: International and enterprise web solutions
chunks.text:
Usaid designed and delivered 10+ websites and digital platforms for clients across India, Latvia and the wider European market. The work covered IT services, enterprise solutions, European business consultancy, education, career platforms, foundations and e-commerce.

Highlights: sites for IT and enterprise solution providers including Oracle-focused services; sites for businesses helping clients establish and grow operations in Latvia and Europe; English and Latvian website experiences; education, internship, foundation and social-impact platforms; WooCommerce and Shopify storefronts alongside WordPress and Elementor builds.

Tech stack: WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify, JavaScript.

chunks.title: Project: Doctor CMS (healthcare content platform)
chunks.text:
Doctor CMS is a custom healthcare content management system that Usaid led as Lead Engineer at Data Innovations Technologies. It gave the organization complete control over its website content and structure without relying on WordPress or any third-party CMS.

Highlights: centralized website content management; database-backed persistent content with real-time website updates; built from the ground up with Next.js, React and TypeScript; Node.js backend with JWT-based authentication and secure APIs; designed for flexible content updates while keeping application control and consistency.

Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, JWT.

chunks.title: Project: NMS, Nursery Management System
chunks.text:
NMS (Nursery Management System) is an end-to-end nursery management platform spanning a web application, backend services and mobile apps, designed to centralize nursery operations with dedicated web and mobile experiences. Usaid contributed across the whole stack.

Highlights: a modern web application built with Next.js, React and TypeScript; Spring and Spring Boot backend services for the core business workflows; React Native apps for both Android and iOS; native Kotlin and Swift integrations for platform-specific capabilities such as the camera.

Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Spring Boot, React Native, Kotlin, Swift.

chunks.title: Project: ExamForge (secure MCQ examination platform)
chunks.text:
ExamForge (HI Tech Examination) is a self-hosted, secure MCQ examination platform that Usaid built as a full-stack developer using Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Prisma.

Highlights: JWT authentication, access control, exam scheduling and secure session management; exam-security features including full-screen enforcement, tab-switch detection, time limits and auto-submit; admin analytics, submission management, audit logging and SMTP email notifications.

Tech stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS, JWT.

chunks.title: AI benchmark engineering: Handshake AI, Project Dynamo
chunks.text:
For Handshake AI's Project Dynamo, Usaid designed and validated a deterministic AI-coding benchmark: forensic recovery of a corrupted content-addressed backup store. The task covers chunk-map reconstruction, content-defined-chunking parameter inference, snapshot/pack chronology recovery and historical-forgery detection.

He built the Docker/Harbor task environment, the verifier and the oracle solution (validated at reward 1.0 against a 0.0 no-op baseline), and debugged GitHub Actions CI and AI-agent evaluation timeout behaviour.

chunks.title: AI benchmark engineering: Snorkel AI, Sentinel Ultra
chunks.text:
For Snorkel AI's Sentinel Ultra, Usaid audited and strengthened repository-level software-engineering benchmarks. This included C / ARM64 NEON SIMD optimization work on Netflix VMAF (cross-compilation, QEMU execution, Docker, Meson, bit-exact scalar-versus-vectorized validation) and a Janet compiler linting / variable-shadowing task.

He identified real SIMD boundary-condition defects, strengthened tests with public-API end-to-end validation, and debugged agent-evaluation and packaging-integrity failures.

chunks.title: Project: this portfolio site and its robot assistant
chunks.text:
This portfolio is a hand-built static site (HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, no framework) deployed on Netlify, with a Netlify Function backend for the contact form and the chat assistant.

The robot in the hero is a procedural Three.js character that tracks the cursor. Clicking it opens this assistant, which is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system: Usaid's resume and portfolio content are split into small knowledge chunks, a BM25 retriever picks the chunks most relevant to each question, and the answer is written only from those chunks. If no language model is configured, the assistant answers directly from the retrieved passages instead.

More of his experiments, tools and open-source work are on GitHub at https://github.com/U-SAIDK.

chunks.title: About this assistant
chunks.text:
This is the portfolio assistant for Usaid Khan: the robot in the hero section. It answers questions about Usaid's background, skills, projects, work experience, certifications, education and how to contact him, using only the content of his portfolio and resume.

It cannot speak for Usaid on things that are not published here, such as salary expectations or personal matters, and it does not answer unrelated general-knowledge questions. For anything it cannot answer, email Usaid at usaidk.tech@gmail.com.
